result.summary: Emits a fatal error during CMake configuration if an MSVC environment is detected without Clang (specifically, cl.exe). This stops configuration early with a pointer to documentation rather than generating unsupported project files.
result.problem: Since PR #31507, Windows builds under Visual Studio only support clang-cl. Invoking CMake without '--preset windows' or '-T ClangCL' defaults to cl.exe, silently creating project files that fail during compilation (such as in minisketchwrapper.c).
evidence: PR description notes that commit 4f1e6de6 (#31507) restricted Visual Studio project generation to clang-cl, but omitting presets still allows CMake to generate broken projects that fail on cl.exe due to missing options like __cplusplus handling.
result.card: Fails CMake configuration with an explicit fatal error if MSVC's cl.exe compiler is detected instead of clang-cl. Since PR #31507, Windows Visual Studio builds only support clang-cl, but invoking CMake without presets or toolset flags defaults to cl.exe and generates project files that fail mid-compilation. Halting early at configure time with a pointer to build documentation saves Windows developers time diagnosing unsupported compiler setups.

risk.why: A mistake in the compiler detection logic could break supported Windows or Clang build configurations.
